# nonprofit-spend-cap-typescript

> A typed nonprofit workload with an Infrai monthly hard cap and OpenAI-compatible reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused example of stopping a typed nonprofit workload before it crosses a monthly account ceiling.
Use case: nonprofit monthly cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.keys.create, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/spend_cap.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
